name: unkeep
description: Privacy-first, self-hosted notes with end-to-end encrypted sync

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @unkeep/core build && pnpm --filter @unkeep/client build && pnpm --filter @unkeep/web dev
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @unkeep/core build && pnpm --filter @unkeep/client build && pnpm --filter @unkeep/cli build
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @unkeep/core build && pnpm --filter @unkeep/client build && pnpm --filter @unkeep/core check && pnpm --filter @unkeep/client check && pnpm --filter @unkeep/cli check && pnpm --filter @unkeep/web check
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @unkeep/core build && pnpm --filter @unkeep/client build && pnpm --filter @unkeep/core test && pnpm --filter @unkeep/client test && pnpm --filter @unkeep/cli test && pnpm --filter @unkeep/web test && pnpm --filter @unkeep/server test
